$comment: Brand-and-claim rules for the LexiPower support pages (luvita-docs#9, EmirErs W7). No build step: python3 .github/scripts/brand-check.py. Schema: https://github.com/AnunnakiCosmoCrew/project-templates/tree/main/actions/brand-claim-check

rules.pattern: © 20\d{2} CosmoCrew — a brand of Luvita Teknoloji Ltd\. Şti\.
rules.why: CLAUDE.md / luvita-docs ADR 0001: every page carries, verbatim and case-sensitively, `© 2026 CosmoCrew — a brand of Luvita Teknoloji Ltd. Şti.` — literal characters (these pages are hand-written UTF-8, no entities), the entity as the link text, luvita.tr as the href and nothing else on the anchor. Only the year moves (ADR 0001: it tracks the current year). This is what a Google for Startups reviewer looked for and did not find (case #00302760).
ADR 0001: `© CosmoCrew` leads and is never replaced by `© Luvita`; the holder is never a person (these pages once read `© 2026 Mert Ertugrul · LexiPower`).
CLAUDE.md: the copyright holder is the company, never a person; do not reintroduce a personal name anywhere, including legal prose.
CLAUDE.md: link to luvita.tr directly, never via cosmocrew.dev; one hop is not enough.
CLAUDE.md: short form of the name only; the full registered trade name contains "Enerji" and belongs in legal-identity blocks on luvita.tr (luvita-web/adr/0003).
LUVITA.md, Brands: the public name is LexiPower, never "WordPower" (rule inventory 58). README.md may name the WordPower-app repository; the served pages may not.
LUVITA.md, Legal entity: the registered office is the founder's home; the street address is never published on our own surfaces (rule inventory 54/118).
